name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Specialization
summary: A Muramite trial arena designed to test mastery of a single combat discipline under Discord‑charged constraints.
description: The Trial of Specialization forces combatants to rely on a single discipline—weapon mastery, spell focus, tactical precision, or defensive technique. Muramite overseers monitor performance and punish deviation from the chosen specialization. Discord pylons destabilize multi‑discipline attempts, forcing combatants to commit fully to their chosen path. Dragorn captives are forced into specialization cycles, while Muramite soldiers prove their mastery of focused combat. Discord constructs adapt to the chosen specialization, creating a dynamic and punishing environment.
